verdict.rationale: The Admin API can delete projects, environments, flags, segments and users, and anything in the dashboard is also available via the API. Self-hosting gives full control over your data, so retention can be governed indirectly through your own infrastructure. There is no evidence of configurable retention policies or windows for identities, audit logs or experimentation event data, and no documented data-subject deletion or erasure workflow. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods, documented retention policy for hosted SaaS data (identities, audit logs, warehouse events), GDPR/erasure-request workflow, independent corroboration.
